chunks: And Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:
Regarding a slave who inflicted a muḍiḥah wound upon one man and then inflicted another upon a second, he said: “It is between them.”

key_terms.بَيْنَهُمَا: Shared between the two injured parties
key_terms.عَبْدٍ: A slave; here, the person whose liability is under discussion
key_terms.مُوضِحَةً: A wound that exposes the bone

ai.seo_question: How is compensation divided when a slave inflicts muḍiḥah wounds on two different people?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about liability when a slave causes similar head wounds to two different people. The Imam عليه السلام states that the compensation is to be shared between the two injured parties.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
regarding a slave who struck one man with a muḍihah wound (a wound that exposes the bone) and then struck another man similarly:
"The compensation is to be divided between them."
